copy.en: Pneumonia causes chest pain, cough with phlegm, fever, and shortness of breath because the alveoli in the lungs become swollen.
copy.tl: Ang pneumonia ay nagdudulot ng pananakit ng dibdib, ubo na may plema, lagnat, at hirap sa paghinga dahil namamaga ang alveoli sa baga.
copy.bis: Ang pneumonia magpahinabo ug sakit sa dughan, ubo nga adunay plema, hilanat, ug kalisod sa pagginhawa tungod kay mohubag ang alveoli sa baga.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A magnet always has two ends called poles
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to explore and describe some ways to use movement, sound, and light to send information between two people
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the poles of a magnet and magnetic forces. G3-F-8 is about using movement, sound, and light to send information between two people. Magnet poles are unrelated to information transfer via movement, sound, or light.

copy.en: A magnet always has two ends called poles - a north pole and a south pole - and invisible magnetic forces push or pull from these ends.
copy.tl: Ang magnet ay laging may dalawang dulo na tinatawag na poles - isang north pole at isang south pole - at mula sa mga dulong ito nagmumula ang hindi nakikitang magnetic force na tumutulak o humihila.
copy.bis: Ang magnet kanunay adunay duha ka tumoy nga gitawag ug poles - usa ka north pole ug usa ka south pole - ug ang dili makitang magnetic force nagduso o nagbira gikan niining mga tumoya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It can cause land, water, and air pollution, which harms all living things.

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses pollution from uncollected waste, not safety precautions for handling household electrical devices. No electrical device or safety content is present.

copy.en:
What happens to garbage that is not collected?

It can cause land, water, and air pollution, which harms all living things.
copy.tl:
Ano ang nangyayari sa basurang hindi nakokolekta?

Maaari itong magdulot ng polusyon sa lupa, tubig, at hangin, na nakakasama sa lahat ng may buhay.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo sa basura nga dili makolekta?

Makapahinabo kini og polusyon sa yuta, tubig, ug hangin, nga makadaot sa tanang buhing butang.

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses pollution and its effect on living things; it contains no information about ion formation, electron loss/gain, or ionic bonds.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Pollution makes air, water, or land dirty

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about pollution, not the periodic table or valence electrons; it provides no support for the competency.

copy.en:
What makes an environment dirty?

Pollution makes air, water, or land dirty, and a dirty environment can make living things sick.
copy.tl:
Ano ang nagpaparumi sa kapaligiran?

Ang pollution ang nagpaparumi sa hangin, tubig, o lupa, at ang maruming kapaligiran ay maaaring magdulot ng sakit sa mga may buhay.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang makahugaw sa kalikopan?

Ang pollution mao ang makahugaw sa hangin, tubig, o yuta, ug ang hugaw nga kalikopan makapasakit sa mga buhing butang.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: population density is different! It is the average number of individuals per unit area or volume
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe that particles are constantly in motion, have spaces between them, attract each other, and move faster as the temperature increases (or with the addition of heat)
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains population density, a biology/ecology concept. It does not describe particles in motion, spacing, attraction, or temperature effects, which are the focus of G7-M-3.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about population density, not about convection or conduction of heat energy or the particle model. No connection to heat transfer processes.

copy.en:
Why does one garden look more crowded than another with the same number of plants?

Because population density is different! It is the average number of individuals per unit area or volume, so plants can be packed tightly or spread out.
copy.tl:
Bakit mas mukhang masikip ang isang hardin kaysa sa isa pa kahit pareho ang bilang ng mga halaman?

Dahil magkaiba ang population density! Ito ay ang average na bilang ng mga indibidwal sa bawat unit ng area o volume, kaya maaaring masikip o maluwag ang pagkakatanim.
copy.bis:
Ngano mas tan-awon nga huot ang usa ka tanaman kaysa sa lain bisan pareho ang gidaghanon sa mga tanom?

Tungod kay lahi ang population density! Kini mao ang average nga gidaghanon sa mga indibidwal sa matag unit sa area o volume, busa mahimong huot o luag ang pagtanom.

copy.tl: Ang population size ay ang bilang ng mga indibidwal sa isang population, tulad ng pagbilang ng lahat ng seedlings na nakatanim sa isang plot.
copy.bis: Ang population size mao ang gidaghanon sa mga indibidwal sa usa ka population, sama sa pag-ihap sa tanang seedlings nga gitanom sa usa ka plot.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Lactation uses positive feedback: suckling stimulates milk production
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: develop a timeline for the historical background of the development of the current Atomic Model that identifies tiny particles as atoms
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a biological positive-feedback mechanism in lactation. G8-M-1 requires developing a timeline for the historical development of the Atomic Model and identifying tiny particles as atoms. There is no connection to atomic theory, matter, or the history of science.

copy.en: Lactation uses positive feedback: suckling stimulates milk production, which causes further feeding, continuing until the baby stops feeding.
copy.tl: Gumagamit ang lactation ng positive feedback: ang pagsuso ay nagpapasigla sa paggawa ng gatas, na nagdudulot ng karagdagang pagpapakain, nagpapatuloy hanggang tumigil ang sanggol sa pagsuso.
copy.bis: Ang lactation mogamit ug positive feedback: ang pagsuso mopadasig sa paghimo ug gatas, nga maoy hinungdan sa dugang nga pagpakaon, magpadayon hangtod nga mohunong ang bata sa pagsuso.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The top oil layer can be poured into another vessel, leaving the water layer at the bottom.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: gather information from secondary sources to explain: a. how typhoons develop, and b. why the Philippines is prone to typhoons
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes decanting an oil layer from water, a mixture separation technique. It provides no information about typhoon development or why the Philippines is prone to typhoons, which is the subject of G8-E-7.

copy.en: The top oil layer can be poured into another vessel, leaving the water layer at the bottom.
copy.tl: Ang layer ng langis sa itaas ay maaaring ibuhos sa ibang sisidlan, na iniiwan ang layer ng tubig sa ilalim.
copy.bis: Ang layer sa lana sa taas mahimong ibubo sa laing sudlanan, nga magbilin sa layer sa tubig sa ubos.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: releasing harmful gases into the air
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use diagrams and illustrations to describe the arrangement, spacing, and relative motion of the particles in each of the three states (phases) of matter
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses pollution from burning fossil fuels in power plants; it does not describe particle arrangement, spacing, or motion in the three states of matter, nor does it use diagrams or illustrations.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: power plants that burn fossil fuels like coal and crude oil
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the physical properties of solid materials, such as hard, shiny, or stretchable
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about air pollution from power plants, not about physical properties of solid materials such as hard, shiny, or stretchable.

copy.en:
Where does the pollution from electricity come from?

It comes from power plants that burn fossil fuels like coal and crude oil, releasing harmful gases into the air.
copy.tl:
Saan nagmumula ang polusyon mula sa kuryente?

Nagmumula ito sa mga power plant na nagsusunog ng fossil fuels tulad ng coal at crude oil, na naglalabas ng mga mapanganib na gas sa hangin.
copy.bis:
Asa maggikan ang polusyon gikan sa kuryente?

Naggikan kini sa mga power plant nga nagsunog og fossil fuels sama sa coal ug crude oil, nga nagpagawas og makadaot nga mga gas ngadto sa hangin.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Earth's wobble, called precession, determines the timing of seasons
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains precession and its effect on seasons, which is an Earth/space science topic. G6-M-6 requires demonstrating mixture separation techniques (decantation, filtering, sieving, etc.). There is no instructional support for the competency.

copy.en: Earth's wobble, called precession, determines the timing of seasons, and in 13,000 years the northern hemisphere will have summer during what is now winter.
copy.tl: Ang pagwawala ng Earth, na tinatawag na precession, ang nagtatakda ng timing ng mga season, at sa loob ng 13,000 taon ang northern hemisphere ay magkakaroon ng summer sa panahong ngayon ay winter.
copy.bis: Ang pag-wobble sa Earth, nga gitawag og precession, mao ang nagtakda sa timing sa mga season, ug sa 13,000 ka katuigan ang northern hemisphere makabaton og summer sa panahon nga karon winter.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Predator-prey relationships are common in ecosystems
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how changes in temperature cause matter to change in state, such as solid to liquid to gas
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses predator-prey relationships, not how temperature changes cause matter to change state. G5-M-6 is about solid to liquid to gas transitions, which is unrelated to the card's content.

copy.en: In predation, the predator benefits by getting food, while the prey is killed or eaten, like a wolf hunting a rabbit.
copy.tl: Sa predation, nakikinabang ang predator sa pagkuha ng pagkain, habang ang prey ay pinatay o kinakain, tulad ng lobo na nangangaso ng kuneho.
copy.bis: Sa predation, ang predator makabenepisyo sa pagkuha ug pagkaon, samtang ang prey gipatay o gikaon, sama sa lobo nga mangayam ug koneho.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scientific models help predict future events
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain in terms of the particle model the processes underlying convection and conduction of heat energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses scientific models for predicting future events (weather forecasts), which is unrelated to the competency's focus on explaining convection and conduction of heat energy using the particle model.

copy.en: Scientific models help predict future events and trends, such as using weather forecasts to warn people about an incoming bagyo.
copy.tl: Nakakatulong ang mga scientific model sa paghula ng mga mangyayari sa hinaharap, tulad ng paggamit ng weather forecast para bigyan ng babala ang mga tao tungkol sa paparating na bagyo.
copy.bis: Ang mga scientific model makatabang sa pagtagna sa umaabot nga mga panghitabo, sama sa paggamit sa weather forecast aron pahimangnoan ang mga tawo mahitungod sa umaabot nga bagyo.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to carefully observe and describe the natural objects commonly seen in the sky during daytime and nighttime, including the Sun, the Moon, planets, and stars
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches chemical nomenclature prefixes for covalent compounds, which has no connection to observing and describing natural objects in the sky (Sun, Moon, planets, stars). The assigned competency is entirely unrelated to the card's content.

copy.en: The prefixes mono-, di-, tri-, and tetra- mean one, two, three, and four atoms of an element in a covalent compound's name.
copy.tl: Ang mga prefix na mono-, di-, tri-, at tetra- ay nangangahulugang isa, dalawa, tatlo, at apat na atom ng isang element sa pangalan ng isang covalent compound.
copy.bis: Ang mga prefix nga mono-, di-, tri-, ug tetra- nagpasabot og usa, duha, tulo, ug upat ka atom sa usa ka element sa ngalan sa usa ka covalent compound.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about earthquake preparedness (emergency kit, evacuation routes), which is unrelated to the competency on reflection and refraction of light using mirrors, lenses, and prisms.

copy.en: Before an earthquake, you should prepare an emergency kit with ready-to-eat food, bottled water, and a first aid kit, and know your evacuation routes.
copy.tl: Bago ang lindol, dapat kang maghanda ng emergency kit na may pagkaing ready-to-eat, bottled water, at first aid kit, at alamin ang iyong mga evacuation routes.
copy.bis: Sa dili pa ang linog, kinahanglan kang mag-andam ug emergency kit nga adunay pagkaon nga ready-to-eat, bottled water, ug first aid kit, ug hibaw-i ang imong mga evacuation routes.

assignedReviews.reason: Card discusses animal reproduction and species preservation; competency is about investigating collisions with models. No relation.

assignedReviews.reason: Card discusses animal reproduction and species preservation; competency is about conservation of momentum in collisions. No relation.

copy.en: Animals have to reproduce to preserve and perpetuate their species, so their kind does not disappear from the Earth.
copy.tl: Kailangang magparami ng mga hayop upang mapanatili at maipagpatuloy ang kanilang species, para hindi mawala ang kanilang uri sa mundo.
copy.bis: Kinahanglang mosanay ang mga mananap aron mapadayon ug mapreserba ang ilang species, aron dili mawala ang ilang matang sa kalibotan.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about pressing a cotton ball, not about weather disturbances or their effects in the Philippines. It is unrelated to the competency.

copy.tl: Ang cotton ball ay nagbabago ng size, shape, at texture kapag pinindot, nagiging mas maliit, mas lapat, at hindi na gaanong malambot.
copy.bis: Ang cotton ball mausab ang size, shape, ug texture kon pisliton, mahimong mas gamay, mas lapad, ug dili na kaayo humok.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to research how to protect and conserve endangered and/or economically important species in the local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about pressing solids, not researching protection or conservation of endangered or economically important species.

copy.en: When you press a solid material like a plastic cup or modeling clay, you change its size and shape, but no new material is formed.
copy.tl: Kapag pinindot mo ang isang solid material tulad ng plastic cup o modeling clay, nababago ang sukat at hugis nito, pero walang bagong material na nabubuo.
copy.bis: Kung imong pug-on ang usa ka solid material sama sa plastic cup o modeling clay, mausab ang gidak-on ug porma, apan walay bag-ong material nga mahimo.

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses pressure and comfort from backpack straps, not factors affecting the movement of objects (size, shape, heaviness, material, surface texture). It does not support the competency's focus on movement.

copy.en: Wide backpack straps feel comfier than thin ones! They spread the weight across more of your shoulder, lowering the pressure so it hurts less.
copy.tl: Mas komportable ang malapad na sintas ng backpack kaysa makitid! Ipinakakalat nito ang bigat sa mas malaking bahagi ng balikat, kaya mababa ang presyon at hindi masakit.
copy.bis: Mas komportable ang lapad nga hikot sa backpack kaysa pig-ot! Nagkatag kini sa gibug-aton sa mas dako nga bahin sa abaga, mao nga ubos ang presyur ug dili sakit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tuberculosis is caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and describe things that affect the movement of objects, including size, shape, heaviness, material, and surface texture
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about tuberculosis prevention and hygiene, with no content about forces, movement of objects, or factors affecting motion.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tuberculosis is caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the physical properties of solid materials, such as hard, shiny, or stretchable
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses a disease and its prevention, not the physical properties of solid materials such as hardness, shininess, or stretchability.

copy.en: Tuberculosis is caused by a bacterium called Mycobacterium, and it can be prevented through good hygiene, proper ventilation, and physical distancing.
copy.tl: Ang tuberculosis ay sanhi ng bacterium na tinatawag na Mycobacterium, at maiiwasan ito sa pamamagitan ng mabuting kalinisan, maayos na bentilasyon, at physical distancing.
copy.bis: Ang tuberculosis gipahinabo sa usa ka bacterium nga gitawag ug Mycobacterium, ug malikayan kini pinaagi sa maayong kalimpyo, saktong bentilasyon, ug physical distancing.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses health benefits of probiotic bacteria; it has no content about separating mixtures (decantation, filtering, sieving, etc.).

assignedReviews.card_evidence: probiotic bacteria
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the benefits of each mixture separation technique in preparing useful products
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not explain benefits of mixture separation techniques; it is entirely about probiotic health effects.

copy.en:
What good do probiotic bacteria do for our bodies?

They are scientifically proven to improve immunity against infections, reduce inflammation and diarrhea, promote weight loss, and protect cardiovascular health.
copy.tl:
Ano ang mabuting nagagawa ng probiotic bacteria sa ating katawan?

Napatunayan ng science na nagpapabuti ito ng immunity laban sa impeksyon, nagbabawas ng inflammation at diarrhea, nakakatulong sa pagbaba ng timbang, at nagpoprotekta sa kalusugan ng puso.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang maayong nahimo sa probiotic bacteria sa atong lawas?

Napamatud-an sa science nga nagpauswag kini sa immunity batok sa impeksyon, nagpamenos sa inflammation ug diarrhea, nakatabang sa pagpaniwang, ug nagprotektar sa kahimsog sa kasingkasing.

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes evolution, a biological process, and provides no information about subatomic particles (protons, neutrons, electrons) or their differentiation.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: draw the structure of an atom in terms of the nucleus and electron shells
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about evolution, not the structure of an atom, nucleus, or electron shells. It does not support drawing or describing atomic structure.

copy.en: Evolution is a developmental process by which all organisms progress from earlier forms of living things over a very long period of time.
copy.tl: Ang evolution ay isang developmental process kung saan ang lahat ng organism ay umuunlad mula sa mga naunang anyo ng mga bagay na may buhay sa napakahabang panahon.
copy.bis: Ang evolution usa ka developmental process diin ang tanang organismo mouswag gikan sa unang mga porma sa mga buhing butang sa taas kaayo nga panahon.

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes products of burning (smoke, flames, light, heat), which is a chemical change topic. It provides no information about drawing or assembling series/parallel circuits, switches, batteries, loads, ammeters, or voltmeters.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about burning producing light and heat, not about current, voltage, resistance, or guided investigations of series/parallel circuits. No instructional support for this competency.

copy.en: Burning wood or coal produces smoke, flames, light, and heat.
copy.tl: Ang pagsunog ng kahoy o coal ay gumagawa ng usok, apoy, liwanag, at init.
copy.bis: Ang pagsunog sa kahoy o coal mopatunghag aso, siga, kahayag, ug kainit.

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses safe storage of materials based on chemical properties, which is unrelated to demonstrating Earth's rotation on its axis to explain day and night.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to explore and record how and when the Sun, the Moon, planets, and stars can be seen moving across the sky
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses safe storage of materials based on chemical properties, which is unrelated to exploring how the Sun, Moon, planets, and stars move across the sky.

copy.en: Proper storage of materials based on their chemical properties keeps everyone safe from fire, rust, and harmful reactions.
copy.tl: Ang wastong pag-iimbak ng mga materyales batay sa kanilang chemical properties ay nagpapanatiling ligtas sa lahat mula sa sunog, kalawang, at mapanganib na reaksyon.
copy.bis: Ang husto nga pagtipig sa mga materyales base sa ilang chemical properties magpabiling luwas sa tanan batok sa sunog, taya, ug peligro nga reaksyon.

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes properties of inorganic compounds (melting/boiling points, bond types).
